name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Disclosures whose height springs open with no overshoot, content fading in as the height lands and the chevron turning on the same spring. Base UI Accordion behaviour.
docs: Import Accordion and AccordionItem from components/eased/accordion/accordion. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
